outcome: peak systolic flow velocity through patent ductus arteriosus (PDA)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of very low birth weight (VLBW) infants born at Los Angeles General Medical Center from May 2015 to August 2023, who had an echocardiogram within the first 7 days of life.
finding: Infants born to mothers with severe preeclampsia showed higher systemic vascular resistance, lower ejection fraction and shortening fraction, and higher pulmonary vascular resistance, but no significant hypertrophic cardiac changes compared to controls.
gest_age: Not specified beyond 'later gestational age' for cases compared to controls
